item.title: Clothes
item.description: Everyday clothes and what you wear.

children.definition: a piece of clothing for the top of your body, with buttons at the front
children.example: My father wears a white shirt to work.

children.definition: a piece of clothing that covers your legs, one part for each leg
children.example: These trousers are too long for me.

children.definition: a piece of clothing for women and girls that hangs down from the waist
children.example: Her school skirt is dark blue.

children.definition: things you wear on your feet, often made of leather
a long warm piece of clothing you wear outside when it is cold
children.example: It's cold today. Wear your coat.

children.definition: a thing you wear on your head
children.example: My grandfather always wears a hat in the sun.

children.definition: soft things you wear on your feet inside your shoes
to have clothes on your body
children.example: I wear a uniform at school.

children.definition: to start wearing a piece of clothing
children.example: Put on your hat. It's cold outside.

children.definition: to remove a piece of clothing from your body
children.example: Please take off your shoes at the door.

children.definition: the things you wear, like shirts, dresses and trousers
children.example: I buy new clothes for Navruz.
